scripts.release: pnpm run release:gate && pnpm run release:pack && pnpm run release:test && changeset publish --from-pack-dir .pack
scripts.release:pack: node -e "fs.rmSync('.pack', { recursive: true, force: true })" && changeset pack --out-dir .pack
scripts.release:test: node scripts/install-test.ts .pack --peers min && node scripts/install-test.ts .pack --peers newest && node scripts/install-test.ts .pack --peers core
